import json, subprocess, sys, copy
BASE = {"cases": [{"initial": [["::/0", 3], ["2001:db8::/128", 7]],
                   "transactions": [[["erase", "2001:db8::/128"]]],
                   "bursts": [{"version": 0, "repeat": 5, "addresses": ["::"]}],
                   "cache_pages": 2,
                   "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 8, "decode": [0, 1, 2]}}]}

def run(obj, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(obj).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = p.stdout.decode()
    return p.returncode, out.strip()

def mutate(fn):
    obj = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    fn(obj)
    return obj

CASES = []
def add(name, obj=None, raw=None):
    CASES.append((name, obj, raw))

add("valid baseline", BASE)
add("duplicate top key", raw=b'{"cases":[],"cases":[]}')
add("extra json value", raw=b'{"cases":[]} {"a":1}')

for name, obj, raw in CASES:
    rc, out = run(obj, raw)
